## Step 1 — Confirm escalated perspectives

The following perspectives were escalated by `a11y-critic` and are subject to deep-layer JTBD checklist review:
- **Keyboard & Motor Access**: HIGH
- **Screen Reader & Semantic Structure**: MEDIUM
- **Cognitive & Neurodivergent**: HIGH

Perspectives rated LOW (Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Auditory Access) are excluded per protocol.

---

## Step 4 & 5 — Per-Perspective Findings

### Perspective: Keyboard & Motor Access
**Checklist Execution:**
- [x] All interactive elements reachable/operable by keyboard (2.1.1) → PASS
- [x] No keyboard traps (2.1.2) → PASS
- [ ] Skip link present and functional (2.4.1) → **FINDING**
- [x] Focus order logical (2.4.3) → PASS
- [x] Focus indicator visible ≥2px, ≥3:1 contrast change (2.4.7, 2.4.13) → PASS (`outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px;`)
- [x] Interactive targets ≥ 24x24px with spacing (2.5.8) → PASS

**Finding:**
```
**Finding:** Missing skip link for long-form feed content
**WCAG:** 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** No `<a href="#feed-container" class="skip-link">` or equivalent bypass mechanism present in component markup. Long feeds require excessive Tab/Scroll cycles for keyboard users.
**Fix:** Add a visually hidden skip link at the top of `<main>` targeting `#feed-container`. Ensure it receives focus on mount and remains accessible via `:focus-visible`.
```

### Perspective: Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Checklist Execution:**
- [x] Layout predictable / visual hierarchy clear → PASS
- [ ] User control over content loading / progress indication → **FINDING**
- [ ] Stable content / no unexpected DOM churn → **FINDING**
- [x] No autoplay media or unprompted modals → PASS

**Finding 1:**
```
**Finding:** Infinite scroll lacks user control and progress indication, causing cognitive navigation breakdown
**WCAG:** 3.2.1 On Focus / Cognitive UX Principles (Predictability & User Control)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** Feed relies exclusively on `IntersectionObserver` scroll-triggered loading. No "Load More" button, pagination, or progress bar is provided. Users cannot pause consumption, track reading position, or control pacing.
**Fix:** Replace auto-scroll loading with a visible "Load More" button. Add a progress indicator (e.g., "Showing 1-20 of 50") to establish clear content boundaries and restore user agency.
```

**Finding 2:**
```
**Finding:** Constant DOM updates via timestamp ticker cause unexpected content changes
**WCAG:** 3.2.1 On Focus / 4.1.3 Status Messages (contextual)
**Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** `useEffect` with `setInterval(() => setTick(t => t + 1), 60000)` forces a full component re-render every 60 seconds, updating all relative timestamps regardless of viewport visibility. This causes unexpected visual shifts for users relying on stable content.
**Fix:** Pause the interval when the feed is not in the viewport (using `IntersectionObserver` or `Visibility API`) or render static timestamps that do not trigger React state updates.
```

### Perspective: Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Checklist Execution:**
- [x] Landmark regions present/correctly used (1.3.1) → PASS (`<main>`)
- [x] Heading hierarchy logical (2.4.6) → PASS (`h1` → `h2`s)
- [x] Informative images have descriptive alt; decorative have `alt=""` (1.1.1) → PASS
- [x] DOM order matches visual reading order (1.3.2) → PASS
- [x] Link text describes destination/purpose (2.4.4) → PASS (uses article titles)
- [ ] Status messages use `aria-live` with appropriate urgency/role (4.1.3) → **FINDING**

**Finding:**
```
**Finding:** Loading state aria-live region lacks explicit role for reliable AT announcement
**WCAG:** 4.1.3 Status Messages
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** `<div aria-live="polite">` wraps the loading spinner without an explicit `role="status"`. Some ATs may not correctly identify it as a status update, potentially silencing the "Loading more articles" announcement.
**Fix:** Add `role="status"` to the live region: `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">`. Ensure the sr-only text remains inside this region for reliable concatenation.
```
